tools.name: move_resumes_to_stage_folder
tools.description: Moves applicants' resume files from the incoming resumes folder into the folder for a hiring stage such as screening, interview or offer. Returns which files were moved and which were missing or skipped.

params.name: applicant_ids
params.description: Applicant IDs whose resume files should be moved

params.name: stage
params.description: Target hiring stage folder: screening, interview, offer or rejected

params.name: root_dir
params.description: Root directory containing the incoming and stage folders

tools.code:
import shutil
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from pathlib import Path

_VALID_STAGES = {"screening", "interview", "offer", "rejected"}
_EXTENSIONS = (".pdf", ".docx", ".doc", ".txt")


@dataclass
class ResumeMoveResult:
    stage: str
    moved: list = field(default_factory=list)
    missing: list = field(default_factory=list)
    skipped: list = field(default_factory=list)
    error: str = ""


def _find_resume(incoming: Path, applicant_id: str):
    for ext in _EXTENSIONS:
        candidate = incoming / f"{applicant_id}{ext}"
        if candidate.is_file():
            return candidate
    return None


def move_resumes_to_stage_folder(applicant_ids: list, stage: str, root_dir: str = "/srv/recruiting/resumes") -> ResumeMoveResult:
    stage = stage.strip().lower()
    result = ResumeMoveResult(stage=stage)

    if stage not in _VALID_STAGES:
        result.error = f"Invalid stage '{stage}'. Choose from {sorted(_VALID_STAGES)}"
        return result

    root = Path(root_dir)
    incoming = root / "incoming"
    if not incoming.is_dir():
        result.error = f"Incoming folder not found: {incoming}"
        return result

    dest_dir = root / stage
    dest_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    for raw_id in applicant_ids:
        applicant_id = str(raw_id).strip()
        if not applicant_id.isalnum():
            result.skipped.append(applicant_id)
            continue
        src = _find_resume(incoming, applicant_id)
        if src is None:
            result.missing.append(applicant_id)
            continue
        target = dest_dir / src.name
        if target.exists():
            result.skipped.append(applicant_id)
            continue
        shutil.move(str(src), str(target))
        result.moved.append(str(target))

    return result
